theme.name: Industrial B2B Multiverse OS - Petrolio & Amber/Volt Yellow
theme.description: Redesigned industrial color palette for MikiLab Pro replacing CYAN with Deep Blu Notte / Petrolio scuro background, Industrial Energetic Orange/Volt Yellow accents, Steel Gray/Platinum structural borders, and pristine reactive status color hierarchy.

typography.notes: Barlow Condensed for high-impact industrial deck headers; JetBrains Mono for telemetry, sensor readouts, and PIN walls.

sereno.label: Sereno (Sky Steel Blue)
sereno.usage: Normal calm operational state, distinct from primary orange accent

attivo.label: Attivo (Industrial Emerald Green)
attivo.usage: Active machinery, running dough mixing, live telemetry

teso.label: Teso (Amber/Industrial Volt Yellow)
teso.usage: Elevated state, warning limits, high temperature alerts

critico.label: Critico (Emergency Crimson Red)
critico.usage: System fault, safety cutoff, emergency stop

instructions_to_main_agent.css_variables_update: Update src/index.css :root variables to set --accent to 24 100% 50% (orange) or update custom classes .holo-root, .holo-panel, .holo-corner to use #FF6B00 instead of #00F0FF.
instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: Map accent color in tailwind.config.js to orange-500 / #FF6B00 and slate-800/900 for dark backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_rule: Ensure all interactive buttons, status indicators, and PIN keypads contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.transparent_bg_prohibition: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for floating headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use backdrop-blur with bg-[#0D1520]/90 or solid #0D1520.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 2-3x generous spacing in command deck widgets.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure secondary platinum text (#CBD5E1) maintains > 4.5:1 ratio against petrolio background (#0D1520).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: Keep reactive deck status semantics distinct: Sky Steel Blue for Sereno, Emerald for Attivo, Yellow/Amber for Teso, Crimson for Critico.
